Q912.reason: Robbery requires a taking by force or fear, but the owner was neither frightened nor deceived and handed over the money voluntarily, so the offense is attempted robbery.

Q925.reason: Greenacre's 'ever consumed' executory interest could vest beyond lives in being plus 21 years, so it is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities and Friend keeps the fee; Blackacre's condition turns on Associate's own conduct, so it is valid and was triggered, sending it to Betty.

Q933.reason: Textbook figures usually cite roughly 350 species, though modern surveys report more, so 350 is the closest option to the commonly quoted value.
